policy: Original unresized 12 MP photo, unchanged input and public peer APIs. Reconstruct all nondominated SSIMULACRA2 frontiers, quarter-score brackets and log-byte sizes without extrapolation. Rehash every full native/Rust endpoint grid, exact metric PNG and prior qualification pin. Freshly encode all six qualified production endpoints through the complete current public package; require identical bytes, unchanged callers and zero retained ownership. Reused grids are explicitly counted separately from fresh encodes. Both complete public packages retain exports and original ceilings. Native settings guide isolated wasm-vips controls only; native bytes are excluded from peer comparisons. Preserve the failed distance-4 wasm-vips attempt in the raw study. Butteraugli tradeoffs remain visible; this is not two-metric dominance, universal compression parity, or a speed/RSS comparison.
